page.layout: One page of text in a single column. At the head: running title centred-left with page number at top right. Below the running head, continuous text paragraphs, then a date line, a centred heading "EPIST. LXIV.", a title block, an address line, a greeting, and the opening paragraph of the letter. Foot: gathering signature "X 5" at left, catchword "se non" at right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: sulto Pontifice, & invitis Clericis capta-[?]ri possint; consideret denique E. V. quid sibi velit in isto libro, & hoc potissimum tempore longa illa disputatio qua contendit in Patriarchatu Romano novum Patriarchatum erigi posse, ut olim Patriarchatus C. P. & Hierosolym; denique utrumque Imperatorum favore sustentatum, Pontificibus licet repugnantibus, vim autoritatemque obtinuisse, cui tandem Pontifices consenserint.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXIV.
Joh. Morinus Cardinali Barberino in favorem Translationis Episcopi Carnu-tensis in Archiepiscopum Rhemen-sem.
main_text.p: PAucos ante dies longâ Epistolâ respondi iis, quæ à me rescire desiderabat Eminentia Vestra. Ipsi datam fuis-

page.notes: Blot over "capta-" at the line end in the first paragraph; the reading "capta-" is doubtful. Ink spots across the page, including one near "Archiepiscopum" and one near "Clericis", do not hide any letters. Long s is written as s throughout. The printed "qvid", "qvæ" and "utrumqve" were normalised to u per the spelling rule, and "deniqve" and "autoritatemqve" likewise. Digitiser banner at bottom right is excluded.
